event_triggers.E1: v0.6.0 event, unchanged: after observing step u, residual (mean of the last W=8 surprises, 12 d.p.) > tau x 0.5, or a window-tier event (as brute/driftsound._note_event)
event_triggers.E2: falsified certificate: the forecast for the taken action at step u carried a conditional certificate c and the observation at u is incompatible with c (bit c not in the observation mask). Constant-free.
event_triggers.E3: single-step surprise: s_u = -ln compatible_mass(published probabilities for u, observation u) > tau (tau6 for 2x2, tau7 for breadth; the frozen ALARM threshold applied to one step instead of the window mean). No new constant. Exact: tau6 = 1.645215 > ln 4 = 1.386294 and tau7 = 2.07944154168 > ln 8 = 2.07944154167984 (margin ~2e-13), so a forecast spread uniformly over all codes never triggers E3; E3 needs the realised observation to have had probability < e^-tau (0.1930 for 2x2, 0.1250 for 8 codes).
event_triggers.note: Inferred: when the published forecast is a certified one, E2 implies E3 (the falsified code carried >= 1-3eps/4 mass, so the compatible mass is <= 3 x eps/4 = 0.015, s >= 4.2 > tau6); E2 is kept as an explicit, constant-free trigger and each event records which triggers fired. Alarms (F4 RESIDUAL_SURPRISE), resume, probabilities and LU-R are NOT changed by E2/E3.

jump_window_definition.region: JumpWindowRegionK(n,k,m,masks,actions,K) = RegionK (same variables, symmetry clause, state bound, first state 0) with at most ONE free transition: for each t in J(T) = {max(1, T-K+1), ..., T-1} a selector j_t (at most one true); the transition clause into observation t holds unless j_t; a transition whose selector is true is not a traversal (Tr counts transition t+1 out of x[t] only if j_{t+1} is false; transitions out of t with t+1 not in J always count). The transition into the LAST observation T is always constrained (lag-1 jumps are NOT covered). With J(T) empty (T <= 1) the region equals RegionK. JW contains every machine of RegionK (all selectors false), so Y1kW contains Y1k (Exact by construction).
jump_window_definition.lag_mapping: a certificate for step s is issued after T = s-1 observations; a drift4 jump at drift step d is the transition into observation d; lag L = s - d; the jump is inside J(T) iff 2 <= L <= K (Exact arithmetic).
jump_window_definition.hull: Y1kW(b, mask) = RegionK.y1k evaluated on JumpWindowRegionK with mask = mask of observation T. UNKNOWN feasibility -> every code (never certifies); y1k UNKNOWN codes count as possible (frozen tri-state semantics).
jump_window_definition.J9: brute.jumpwindow.WindowSyncLearner: brute.align.AlignedSyncLearner (SP8: SyncEventLearner rule CTR + LU-C) unchanged, plus: a certificate c that SP8 keeps (taken or counterfactual action) is kept only if Y1kW(action, mask_T) == {c} (cert_rule <SP8 path> + "+whull"), else ABSTAIN / RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS with cert_rule "whull-downgraded". Hull queries go through RegionSpace._q (memo key ("y1kW", action, mask)) so their unknowns count toward SOLVER_BUDGET. The LU-C lookahead is NOT changed (it counts what SP8 would certify, not what J9 keeps; disclosed). hull_union / hull_unknown are recorded per step while the family is supported (as J8).
jump_window_definition.not_selective_by_surprise: NEXT_ITERATION proposed applying the hull only after an unsurprising observation; the seen data had no event between drift and certificate in 28/28, so that condition would almost always hold. J9 is selective by POSITION (window excluding the last transition), not by surprise (Inferred, disclosed).

J10_definition.rule: brute.supportwindow.SupportWindowLearner = brute.jumpwindow.WindowSyncLearner with ONE change: the kept-certificate test uses supW(action) = RegionK.support(action) evaluated on JumpWindowRegionK(K=4) (the exact projection of the next code after `action` over every (machine, at most one window jump) consistent with the evidence; frozen tri-state: UNKNOWN codes count as possible; UNKNOWN feasibility -> every code) instead of Y1kW. A certificate c that SP8 keeps survives iff supW(action) == {c} (cert_rule <SP8 path> + "+wsupp"), else ABSTAIN / RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS, cert_rule "wsupp-downgraded". Memo key ("supW", action) through RegionSpace._q (unknowns count toward SOLVER_BUDGET). hull_union / hull_unknown record supW(0), supW(1) per step while the family is supported. LU-C unchanged (so J10, J9 and SP8 take the same actions on the same case unless a solver UNKNOWN differs).
J10_definition.soundness_argument: Inferred/Exact by construction: J10 certificates are a subset of SP8 certificates; when the true (machine, jump) is inside the window region the true next code is in supW, so a singleton supW is the true code (same containment as J9; lag 1 is covered in the same sense as J9 since J(T) includes T-1 and the transition into T stays constrained).
J10_definition.big78: brute.bigstate.big(cls) wraps a learner class: constructed with the frozen symbolic caps (5, 6) and then its family / margin RegionSpace replaced by RegionSpace(8) / RegionSpace(9), family string deterministic-moore<=8/stationary (the attestation names that family). The recency-window tier keeps its frozen <= 4 bound (disclosed: it is only used after a contradiction).

transfer_definition.source_learning: brute.transfer.learn_motifs(initial_obs, actions, observations): fully observed source (mask 0.0, 60 steps). Backtracking search over partial Moore machines with states numbered in order of first visit (start = 0), n = 1..4 in increasing order; at the smallest n with a consistent machine ALL consistent machines are enumerated (cap library_solution_cap = 64; above the cap the library is EMPTY = no transfer). Each solution is abstracted to a motif: n, the traversed transitions, the emission CLASS pattern (codes renumbered by first appearance), untraversed transitions left open.
transfer_definition.target_hypotheses: every motif expanded over: action relabelling (identity, swap), every injective map of emission classes to the 4 codes, every start state, every completion of open transitions; deduplicated after canonical renumbering from the start state; cap hypothesis_cap = 200000 (above it: no transfer). Each hypothesis is a concrete (transitions, emissions, current state).
transfer_definition.TR_arm: TR runs inside the SP8 trajectory of the target (same actions, same SP8 forecasts; TR never chooses actions). Hypotheses are filtered by every target observation (bit-compatible emission of the tracked state). For action b at a step after burn_in: if SP8 certifies, TR = SP8 certificate; else if the surviving set is non-empty, every survivor predicts the same next code c, SP8 is family-supported and c is in the SP8 published support -> TR certifies c (cert_rule "transfer"); else TR abstains. An empty surviving set disables transfer for the rest of the case (logged step). TR is evaluator-side bookkeeping on learner-visible data only (the library is learned from source OBSERVATIONS; hidden truth never reaches it).
transfer_definition.pairs: positive: target family f uses the library of source seed 5150000 + 24 x index(f) + offset (same family f; index order cycle3, switch3, unaliased2, ood4). negative control: target f uses the library of the same offset from the ROTATED family: cycle3 <- switch3, switch3 <- cycle3, unaliased2 <- ood4, ood4 <- unaliased2. Both TR variants (TRp, TRn) are evaluated on the same SP8 target trajectory.
transfer_definition.cases: 4 families x 24 target seeds x 3 masks = 288 target cases; 96 source worlds
transfer_definition.not_run: unstructured3 and perm4 (fresh random structure per seed, so no shared motif by construction) are not transfer targets in this study, to fit the cap (disclosed).
